Package httyd.data

Class GachaService

java.lang.Object
httyd.data.GachaService
public class GachaService extends Object
The dragon egg: rolls a species by rarity, then the stat deviations (IV), a nature and the chance of an Alpha dragon.

  • Method Details

    • pickSpecies

      public DragonSpecies pickSpecies(int rarityPercent)
      Picks a species. The chance of a species is its tier weight divided by the number of species of that tier, so a tier is as common as its weight says.
      Parameters:
      rarityPercent - 100 for normal rates; above 100 favours S and A tiers, below 100 favours B and C
      Returns:
      the species

    • rollDragon

      Returns:
      the new dragon at 1 star
